title: packet-silabs-dch: use pinfo->pool
description:
Remove `wmem_packet_scope()` calls. Add a `wmem_allocator_t *scope`
argument to functions which allocate memory, and pass `pinfo->pool` when
calling them.

These changes are small steps toward potential future concurrency
support in Wireshark as envisioned
[here](https://www.wireshark.org/lists/wireshark-dev/202107/msg00052.html).
